label_122: v1.22.0 — 'Best in Class' Phase 2: Routes + Next Gen Stats (2016+). New 'Receiving · Routes' group on RB/WR/TE/Flex-O — Routes run, Route% of team dropbacks, TPRR (targets per route run) and YPRR (yards per route run), the industry's headline per-route stats, from nflverse participation data. New NGS tracking groups — WR/TE: Separation, Cushion, xYAC± (YAC over expected); RB: RYOE/Att (rush yards over expected — the isolate-the-runner-from-his-line stat), Efficiency, 8+Box%; QB: Time-to-Throw, AGG% (tight-window throws). label: v1.20.0 — Expected Points: SKILL vs LUCK. The ± now decomposes into a TD-luck bucket (TD±, ~zero year-to-year stability) and a yards+receptions skill bucket (Eff±), plus Sustain± (the reliability-weighted, sample-shrunk part projected to carry forward — calibrated on 20 seasons of split-half reliability) and Luck± (the rest, regresses). 'vs Self' measures each player against his OWN multi-year baseline (years 1-3 use a UPS draft-slot prior that ramps to their own data), 'Backed' is the independent skill support (separation / target share / ADOT / YAC / EPA / CPOE), and 'Call' is a synthesized Buy-low / Hold / Sell-high. (v1.19.1: ± tie-out fix; v1.19.0: xFP added.)
changes_120: Horizontal scrollbar moved to the TOP of the table (synced two-way); the table now scrolls in a bounded 680px region so the scrollbar + column header stay fixed while the body scrolls (works in the iframe embed, not just standalone).
